author: More Perfect Union
description:
In the last decade, credit card companies have nearly doubled their interest rates — and in 2024, Americans paid $170 billion in credit card interest.

A former employee told us the companies operate like “loan sharks."
title: How Credit Card Companies Are Robbing You

author: More Perfect Union
description:
A full 10% of NYC Trump voters turned around and voted for Zohran Mamdani.
So we went to talk to them.
These voters are done with the status quo. One New Yorker told us: "As Americans, we can realize it's not Republican versus Democrat. It's more of like a class war."
